terrainrecorder.help.recmode.title: === Extend / trim a snapshot (/recmode, alias /rcm) ===
terrainrecorder.help.recmode.body:
/recmode add (/rcm a) — align to a snapshot, then add blocks you see that the map does not have (extend)
/recmode min (/rcm m) — align to a snapshot, then remove blocks that have vanished (trim); removed blocks are marked blue
/recmode stop (/rcm s) — finish and write the result back to the base snapshot
/recmode (/rcm) with no arguments — show this help
Subcommand aliases: add=a, min=m, stop=s
Related: /rec (/rc) save a snapshot; /find highlight differences; /delrec delete snapshots
terrainrecorder.help.delrec.title: === /delrec (delete snapshots) ===
terrainrecorder.help.delrec.body:
/delrec <id>             — delete the given snapshot (id is the timestamp in the file name, Tab to complete)
/delrec all              — delete every snapshot in the current server folder
/delrec all else <keep>  — delete all but keep (keep = snapshot id, or latest = keep the newest)
/delrec (no arguments)    — show this help
terrainrecorder.help.export.title: === /rec export (export a zip, alias /rcex) ===
terrainrecorder.help.export.body:
/rec export [<id>...] [-a | -a-f] [-o <name>]  — pack snapshots into one zip
  <id>: snapshot id or custom file name (no suffix, repeatable, Tab to complete); omit → every snapshot of this server
  -a: all snapshots of this server (same as the default)
  -a-f (or -af): all snapshots of all servers (skips the zips folder)
  -o <name>: written under terrain_snapshots/zips/, .zip is appended automatically; omit -o → snapshot_<timestamp>.zip
  zip layout: <server>/<file>.snap
  /rec export (no arguments) — show this help
terrainrecorder.help.import.title: === /rec import (import a zip, alias /rcim) ===
terrainrecorder.help.import.body:
/rec import (/rcim) [-x <zip path>] [-f]  — import snapshots from a zip
  -x <zip path>: path relative to terrain_snapshots/zips/ (may be omitted; without a path a file dialog opens), Tab to complete
  -f: overwrite existing files without asking; without -f each conflict gets clickable buttons in chat (overwrite / skip / overwrite all / cancel all)
  Android/iOS can only import from the zips folder; non-.snap files are ignored
  The zip contains <server>/<file>.snap and is restored into each server's folder
  /rec import (no arguments) — show this help
